By leveraging tools like NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare for delivery, you can build a fully operational digital storefront without relying on conventional payment platforms.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms impose high fees, with services like Gumroad taking up to 10% per sale. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, which significantly increases your earnings. For instance, processing 100 sales of a $97 product on Gumroad would cost you $970, whereas the fee with NOWPayments would only be $49. This difference of $921 can be reinvested into your business or used to enhance your offerings. Additionally, with COREMERCH, you retain full ownership and control over your digital assets, eliminating the risk of account bans or restrictions imposed by third-party services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To begin, you need a clear understanding of your digital products and how you plan to deliver them. Gather your assets such as ebooks, courses, templates, or software. You also need accounts with the necessary tools: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file storage. Lastly, ensure you have your product pricing established in USD for seamless conversion during transactions. Preparing these elements in advance will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your chosen infrastructure stack, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack for basic needs or the Edge Commerce Stack for more robust functionality. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrencies and set up automatic payment verification. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your digital products upon confirmed payments. Ensure that your delivery mechanism is tested and functioning correctly, allowing customers to access their purchases immediately after payment completion. This setup ensures a smooth transaction experience, crucial for customer satisfaction.
Retain full ownership of your digital assets with COREMERCH.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it’s time to go live. Share your store link with your audience, utilizing social media platforms, networks, or your existing user base to drive traffic. Monitor your transactions closely in the initial phase to ensure everything operates smoothly. When a customer makes a purchase, confirm that the payment is processed through NOWPayments and that the delivery automation triggers correctly. This step is vital for validating your system’s reliability and providing a seamless experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is functioning smoothly, consider ways to scale. Analyze customer feedback to improve your offerings and explore marketing strategies to reach a wider audience. Integrate additional digital products into your store and utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store’s capabilities. Keep optimizing your processes to handle increased traffic and sales, ensuring that your infrastructure can support growth without platform dependencies.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate product delivery seamlessly with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers.

Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital products and prepare your assets for deployment. Create accounts with GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting, NOWPayments for processing, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storage. Deploy your chosen infrastructure stack. Set up automated payment verification with NOWPayments. Test your delivery mechanism to ensure customers receive their purchases immediately after payment. Share your store link and monitor transactions closely.
